column1: # Org-wide pushed_at snapshot — irreducible-mystery, refreshed 2026-08-13 ~07:00 UTC
# WAKE REFRESH. One row moved since the 08-09 snapshot: juliasynth1, the
# Level-1 twin, at 2026-08-13T01:51:23Z (wave 21 — an instrument confession,
# not a system event). Level 0 unchanged: julia2 08-07T02:34, julia3claude
# WHY: the seismograph fingerprints only cloned repos and is structurally
# blind to (a) repos that do not exist yet and (b) repos never cloned.
# Epoch 8 missed three new repos; epoch 12 missed an archipelago repo
# waking after five days. Both were caught only by org enumeration held in
# session context — which dies with the session. This file puts the whole
# org's state in the record so any future cycle can diff it.
# A third blindness, confessed 2026-08-13: even for cloned repos the
# fingerprint tracks refs/heads only. refs/pull/* is invisible to it, and
# pushed_at here does not move for pull-request activity either.
# PROTOCOL: each check-in, list_repos and compare against this table;
# any changed pushed_at is motion, whether or not the repo is watched.
